diagnosis: The organization session revocation endpoint queries the express-mysql-session database table directly and terminates all active sessions of targetUserId. It fails to check whether the calling manager has authority over req.params.orgId or whether targetUserId actually belongs to that organization. A manager of Organization A can terminate all active sessions of executives in rival Organization B, disrupting operational business activities.
exploit_request:
POST /api/orgs/org_small_team/sessions/revoke-user HTTP/1.1
Host: console.multitenant-crm.com:8097
Authorization: Bearer <manager_org_a_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"targetUserId": "usr_ceo_organization_b"}
